evidence.reason: Left edit adds +3 to the value returned by evaluate/reminderUnit, changing the function's output magnitude.
Right edit swaps priorities from [multiplier, multiplier/2] to [multiplier/2, multiplier], so priorities[0] used in Math.floor changes from multiplier to multiplier/2, altering the computed delay.
evaluate value-references reminderDelay, so the right edit propagates through evaluate into scheduledDelay's result.
Only asserts scheduledDelay(40) > 0, which still holds after both edits, so tests do not detect the joint behavioral change.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动叠加后，scheduledDelay 的返回值既被 +3 又被 reminderDelay 中优先级顺序调换所影响，现有测试只检查大于 0，无法确认行为是否仍符合预期。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/reminders.ts 中 reminderDelay 的作者确认 priorities 顺序调换是否有意为之；若无必要，应恢复为 [multiplier, multiplier / 2]，并让 src/scheduling.ts 中 scheduledDelay 的作者说明 +3 偏移的用途，同时补充断言具体数值的测试。
